## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an elevated error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` showed v2.3.1 deployed everywhere and unhealthy; `list_deployments` confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release, with v2.3.0 as the most recent healthy production version.
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially failed (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error), leaving us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1. I retried the rollback, which completed successfully — all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback. The initial call timed out, but verification confirmed the incident was created and is open.

**Final state:** checkout-api is on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.
